integrity: Proof and source comparisons are supplied; validation is limited to self-review and a separate algorithmic exhaustive check. No independent mathematical audit or priority certification has occurred.
limitations: The theorem covers labelled simple fans K_1 join P_n for all all path orders at least two, not all chordal graphs. It counts acyclic orientations by vertex indegree parity, not topological orders. Finite exhaustive checks do not prove the unbounded theorem; the unrestricted proof is combinatorial. Residual bibliographic risk exists.
title: Exact parity fibres and all obstructions for acyclic orientations of fan graphs
